title: UniFi Network Health
description: Gateway health, throughput, existing speed-test metrics and eight clients per page with collapsed filtering. No speed test is triggered. Client names, IPs and MACs are intentionally displayed. The separate third-party public-IP lookup is excluded. Requires the included Python collector and a compatible UniFi OS console with a dedicated view-only account. Setup: see this package's INSTALL.md in the public source release. Add an approved public source URL before submitting. Configure actual service URLs and credentials locally after import; never upload them to Workshop.
changelog: Initial public release; portable example URLs and documented local setup.
